important_invariants_and_limits: TX count<=remaining and<=64, RX count<=64; active/zero/reset consistency and valid command words are checked.
TX sent+remaining is bounded by0xffffff, but is not required to equal reprogrammable live TX_LEN.
RX received>=rx_count is not an invariant: a new RX command resets the counter while canceled-command FIFO data may remain; the uint32 counter can wrap.
Unused FIFO tail bytes are preserved and exposed; enabled-profile migration does not require them to be zero.
Disabled profile requires default register/FIFO/counter state and keeps both regions unmapped.
Backend work requires an enabled running reference with validated migration state; functional QTest work must resume before TX/RX.
Full actual original cold-probe IRQ masks are supported, including mode3 DMA IRQ-mask SET aliases; DMA enable and transfer/status paths remain explicit errors.
No live physical SE6 revision, reset, FIFO geometry, UART image assignment or wrapper hardware value is claimed.
